title: IFAD Internship Programme
description: A paid, six-month internship at the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), a United Nations specialized agency headquartered in Rome, Italy, focused on rural poverty reduction and agricultural development. Applications are genuinely rolling -- IFAD does not run application cycles or set deadlines; candidates may submit at any time and are considered as relevant openings arise. Interns receive a monthly allowance (reported at roughly USD 670-740, based on a percentage of the duty station's daily subsistence rate); through the Enhanced Internship Programme, interns from developing countries who need to travel to Rome for the assignment receive a higher allowance that also contributes to housing and travel costs. Applicants must be 30 years old or younger, fluent in English, and either currently enrolled in an accredited university or graduate school with at least two undergraduate years completed (and course attendance within the last 24 months), or have completed university studies at the undergraduate or postgraduate level within the last 24 months. Open to citizens of any country.
visaNote: This is a paid internship, not standard employment; interns are responsible for their own visa/residence-permit arrangements to work in Italy for the internship's duration.
